The `one-store-apply` proposal is clear, so I logged one "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags.

The proposal is an agent brief rather than an owner-facing page, so I did not open it as a page or take a screenshot. It states the four deliverables in order, the budget, the fence and who to coordinate with.

The title, "One tree, applied: the Inbox cards move into the sessions store", runs to 11 words against the 5–8 the content standard asks for. I left it, since only agents read this file.
